title: Ship a unified portable Codex as Code distribution

acceptance_criteria: Installed coherent cac command and generic-only reproducible distribution.
Saved plan binds source and local ownership; stale plans refuse before writes.
Use actual CaC lifecycle, ownership and deployment features during product development, record concrete limitations.
verification: 99 regression tests pass; 12 installed CLI checks pass outside source checkout.
Reproducible generic wheel builds and real enrolled-host saved-plan apply/readback observed.
independent_review: Read-only independent review found no concrete trust-boundary blocker; spawn-error hypothesis disproved with regression.
rollback_operations: Explicit previous-package reinstall and service restart; source revert requires refreshed lifecycle evidence.
